intervention: same block parameters applied several times per token (layer schedule = list of block indices); factory replacement of train_depth_ar.DepthARModel

train.optimizer: AdamW(wd=0.01) + warmup 200 steps + cosine to 0.1x (shared train())

data.split: first 90M train / last 10M eval, vocab from full file

arms.role: same-parameter dense control (6 distinct layers, 6 passes)
same-compute dense control (12 distinct layers, 12 passes)
main arm: the whole 6-layer stack applied twice (same params as dense6, same passes as dense12)
diagnostic arm: only the back half (layers 4-6) is repeated, front half used once; same params and same passes as repeat2x

macs_model.note: analytic, per token; attention term is the causal average T*d (T/2 keys x 2 passes over d)

eval.metric: clean bpc = final-depth readout, sequence-level, lower better
eval.autocast: off (fp32, same instrument as the 2654 anchor)

P0_engine_equivalence.rule: re-evaluate the anchor checkpoint with this experiment's eval code; |diff| < 0.002

criteria.P1_liveness: block calls per forward == passes; identity schedule == stock logits bitwise; repeat arms' full schedule deviates from prefix schedule (> 0)
criteria.P2_answer_1_same_compute: paired delta clean bpc (dense12 - repeat2x), 0.014 band
criteria.P2_answer_2_same_params: paired delta clean bpc (dense6 - repeat2x), 0.014 band
criteria.P2_diagnostic: paired delta clean bpc (repeat2x - repeat2x-tail) and (dense12 - repeat2x-tail), 0.014 band
criteria.delta_sign_convention: delta(candidate vs control) = bpc_control - bpc_candidate; positive = candidate better
